newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains lower, hit by sterling.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains lower, hit by sterling.

text.p: LIFFE grains ended down, hit by a recovery in sterling's value against the mark.
But uncertainty and a lack of physical grain coming in kept volume small. With no farmer selling and rain delaying the harvest, the trade was left with a quiet end to the week.
Short covering provided some support, as buyers looked to futures in the absence of delivered market oppurtunities.
November dominated wheat, with 271 of a total 361 lots done. It last traded 0.50 stg lower at 84.40 stg.
November also dominated barley, with 25 of the total 35 lots. It last traded 0.75 stg down at 79.40 stg.
Physical market traders reported a market still stifled by a lack of farmer selling and rain which has slowed work in the fields.
